movies.overview: When the son of an L.A. mayoral candidate is kidnapped, he and his wife have a few hours to come up with the ransom payment. With most of their money spent on his political campaign, they have to get their hands dirty and expose a side of their lives they never intended to see the light of day.
movies.tagline: Power can't protect you.
movies.title: Animals

movies.original_title: No dejes a los niños solos
movies.overview: A mother moves into a new house with her two children. One night she must leave the siblings home alone. What begins as a blast of carefree play soon turns into a claustrophobic horror story.
movies.title: Don't Leave the Kids Alone

movies.overview: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.
movies.tagline: The ascent that made history.
movies.title: Tenzing

movies.overview: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.
movies.tagline: Rise or die.
movies.title: The Uprising

movies.overview: After a chance encounter sparks a sweeping romance, Maya's future is suddenly upended, sending her on an unexpected journey to love and live again.
movies.title: Love of Your Life

movies.overview: A sexy Spanish siren named Elvira schools a young man in tantric lovemaking.
movies.tagline: When sexual fantasies come true.
movies.title: Don't Look Down

movies.overview: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.
movies.tagline: A man. A plan. A meltdown.
movies.title: Digger

movies.overview: After losing his father, Ethan Nichols inherits one of the largest greenhouses in the country, just as the world faces a devastating threat from an approaching asteroid. As society begins to unravel, Ethan grapples with personal betrayal, overwhelming loneliness, and the growing fear that survival may come at the cost of his humanity. Seeking refuge in his family’s bunker, Ethan endures the harsh aftermath of the impact, wrestling with physical injury and emotional despair. When a faint voice crackles over his radio, Ethan discovers he's not as alone as he believed.
movies.title: After Impact

movies.overview: Racing legend Sonny Hayes is coaxed out of retirement to lead a struggling Formula 1 team—and mentor a young hotshot driver—while chasing one more chance at glory.
movies.tagline: Let's ride.
movies.title: F1

movies.overview: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage.
movies.tagline: Mankind was born on Earth. It was never meant to die here.
movies.title: Interstellar

movies.overview: When 11-year-old Riley moves to a new city, her Emotions team up to help her through the transition. Joy, Fear, Anger, Disgust and Sadness work together, but when Joy and Sadness get lost, they must journey through unfamiliar places to get back home.
movies.tagline: Meet the little voices inside your head.
movies.title: Inside Out

movies.overview: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer's role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II.
movies.tagline: The world forever changes.
movies.title: Oppenheimer

movies.overview: After more than thirty years of service as one of the Navy’s top aviators, and dodging the advancement in rank that would ground him, Pete “Maverick” Mitchell finds himself training a detachment of TOP GUN graduates for a specialized mission the likes of which no living pilot has ever seen.
movies.tagline: Feel the need... The need for speed.
movies.title: Top Gun: Maverick

movies.overview: Thirty years after the events of the first film, a new blade runner, LAPD Officer K, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos. K's discovery leads him on a quest to find Rick Deckard, a former LAPD blade runner who has been missing for 30 years.
movies.tagline: The key to the future is finally unearthed.
movies.title: Blade Runner 2049

movies.overview: Desperate to reclaim her career, once-beloved actress Samantha Lake is drawn into the glamorous world of wellness mogul Zoe Shannon - only to uncover a monstrous truth beneath its flawless surface.
movies.tagline: Be the best version of yourself.
movies.title: Shell

movies.overview: Based on the real life story of legendary cryptanalyst Alan Turing, the film portrays the nail-biting race against time by Turing and his brilliant team of code-breakers at Britain's top-secret Government Code and Cypher School at Bletchley Park, during the darkest days of World War II.
movies.tagline: The true enigma was the man who cracked the code.
movies.title: The Imitation Game

movies.overview: Noah must leave her city, boyfriend, and friends to move into William Leister's mansion, the flashy and wealthy husband of her mother Rafaela. As a proud and independent 17 year old, Noah resists living in a mansion surrounded by luxury. However, it is there where she meets Nick, her new stepbrother, and the clash of their strong personalities becomes evident from the very beginning.
movies.tagline: Love can only survive in the shadow of secrets.
movies.title: My Fault

movies.overview: When an innovative modern architect flees post-war Europe, he is given the opportunity to rebuild his legacy. Set during the dawn of the modern United States (in Pennsylvania), his wife joins him, and their lives are forever changed by a demanding, wealthy patron.
movies.tagline: Welcome to America.
movies.title: The Brutalist

movies.overview: Spanning the years 1945 to 1955, a chronicle of the fictional Italian-American Corleone crime family. When organized crime family patriarch, Vito Corleone barely survives an attempt on his life, his youngest son, Michael steps in to take care of the would-be killers, launching a campaign of bloody revenge.
movies.tagline: An offer you can't refuse.
movies.title: The Godfather

movies.overview: After the death of Emperor Marcus Aurelius, his devious son takes power and demotes Maximus, one of Rome's most capable generals who Marcus preferred. Eventually, Maximus is forced to become a gladiator and battle to the death against other men for the amusement of paying audiences.
movies.tagline: What we do in life echoes in eternity.
movies.title: Gladiator

movies.overview: When an American heir living in a luxurious Spanish villa decides to move in with his girlfriend, his departure triggers a family collapse as his brother uncovers the truth behind their mother's tragic death.
movies.tagline: People are roses. Families are rosebushes. Rosebushes need pruning.
movies.title: Rosebush Pruning

movies.overview: Imprisoned in the 1940s for the double murder of his wife and her lover, upstanding banker Andy Dufresne begins a new life at the Shawshank prison, where he puts his accounting skills to work for an amoral warden. During his long stretch in prison, Dufresne comes to be admired by the other inmates -- including an older prisoner named Red -- for his integrity and unquenchable sense of hope.
movies.tagline: Fear can hold you prisoner. Hope can set you free.
movies.title: The Shawshank Redemption

movies.overview: Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.
movies.tagline: We're way past making friends.
movies.title: The Social Reckoning

movies.overview: A young woman from the Midwest gets more than she bargained for when she moves to New York to become a writer and ends up as the assistant to the tyrannical, larger-than-life editor-in-chief of a major fashion magazine.
movies.tagline: Meet Andy Sachs. A million girls would kill to have her job. She's not one of them.
movies.title: The Devil Wears Prada

movies.overview: When a storm traps old university pals at a luxury lodge, their civilized birthday bash spirals into a cyclone of betrayals, grudges and unfiltered chaos.

production_companies.name: Warner Bros. International Television Production Sweden

movies.title: The Storm

movies.overview: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.
movies.tagline: No one knows your heart like a sister.
movies.title: Sense and Sensibility

movies.overview: Years after witnessing the death of the revered hero Maximus at the hands of his uncle, Lucius is forced to enter the Colosseum after his home is conquered by the tyrannical Emperors who now lead Rome with an iron fist. With rage in his heart and the future of the Empire at stake, Lucius must look to his past to find strength and honor to return the glory of Rome to its people.
movies.tagline: Prepare to be entertained.
movies.title: Gladiator II

movies.overview: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice.
movies.tagline: Are you ready to make television history?
movies.title: Primetime

movies.overview: Sister Agnès runs away from her convent in Brittany and seeks refuge in Paris with prostitute Mona Lisa. With absolutely no qualifications, the young novice has a hard job finding work, so Mona Lisa tries to teach her the ropes of the oldest profession of them all!
movies.title: The Novices

movies.overview: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.
movies.tagline: One summer to feel everything.
movies.title: The Last Sunrise

movies.overview: Macau Police brings the tracking expert police officer out of retirement to help catch a dangerous group of professional thieves.

production_companies.name: iQIYI Pictures （重复 同 iQiyi Motion Pictures）

movies.tagline: He's training a new generation of law enforcers for a dangerous mission to save the world from ruthless criminals.
movies.title: The Shadow's Edge

movies.overview: 101-year-old Rose DeWitt Bukater tells the story of her life aboard the Titanic, 84 years later. A young Rose boards the ship with her mother and fiancé. Meanwhile, Jack Dawson and Fabrizio De Rossi win third-class tickets aboard the ship. Rose tells the whole story from Titanic's departure through to its death—on its first and last voyage—on April 15, 1912.
movies.tagline: Nothing on earth could come between them.
movies.title: Titanic

movies.overview: Under the direction of a ruthless instructor, a talented young drummer begins to pursue perfection at any cost, even his humanity.
movies.tagline: Do your best, he said…
movies.title: Whiplash

movies.overview: The story of Michael Jackson, one of the most influential artists the world has ever known, and his life beyond the music. His journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fueled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world, highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career.
movies.tagline: Discover the making of a king.
movies.title: Michael

movies.overview: After his wife dies, a blacksmith named Balian is thrust into royalty, political intrigue and bloody holy wars during the Crusades.
movies.tagline: Be without fear in the face of your enemies. Safeguard the helpless, and do no wrong
movies.title: Kingdom of Heaven

movies.overview: Andy Sachs returns to Runway as Miranda Priestly navigates a new media landscape and Runway's position within. The duo reconnect with former assistant Emily Charlton, now the head of a luxury brand that possesses funding which could ensure Runway's survival.
movies.tagline: Icons reign forever.
movies.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2

movies.overview: The men who made millions from a global economic meltdown.
movies.tagline: This is a true story.
movies.title: The Big Short

movies.overview: A cold and mysterious new security guard for a Los Angeles cash truck company surprises his co-workers when he unleashes precision skills during a heist. The crew is left wondering who he is and where he came from. Soon, the marksman's ultimate motive becomes clear as he takes dramatic and irrevocable steps to settle a score.
movies.tagline: A one man army.
movies.title: Wrath of Man

movies.overview: A supernatural tale set on death row in a Southern prison, where gentle giant John Coffey possesses the mysterious power to heal people's ailments. When the cell block's head guard, Paul Edgecomb, recognizes Coffey's miraculous gift, he tries desperately to help stave off the condemned man's execution.
movies.tagline: Paul Edgecomb didn't believe in miracles. Until the day he met one.
movies.title: The Green Mile

movies.overview: When oil is discovered in 1920s Oklahoma under Osage Nation land, the Osage people are murdered one by one—until the FBI steps in to unravel the mystery.
movies.tagline: Can you find the wolves in this picture?
movies.title: Killers of the Flower Moon

movies.overview: In Nazi-occupied France during World War II, a group of Jewish-American soldiers known as "The Basterds" are chosen specifically to spread fear throughout the Third Reich by scalping and brutally killing Nazis. The Basterds, lead by Lt. Aldo Raine soon cross paths with a French-Jewish teenage girl who runs a movie theater in Paris which is targeted by the soldiers.
movies.tagline: Once upon a time in Nazi occupied France...
movies.title: Inglourious Basterds

movies.overview: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.
movies.tagline: He was no hero.
movies.title: The Death of Robin Hood

movies.overview: The untold story of Katherine G. Johnson, Dorothy Vaughan and Mary Jackson – brilliant African-American women working at NASA and serving as the brains behind one of the greatest operations in history – the launch of astronaut John Glenn into orbit. The visionary trio crossed all gender and race lines to inspire generations to dream big.
movies.tagline: Meet the women you don't know, behind the mission you do.
movies.title: Hidden Figures

movies.overview: As U.S. troops storm the beaches of Normandy, three brothers lie dead on the battlefield, with a fourth trapped behind enemy lines. Ranger captain John Miller and seven men are tasked with penetrating German-held territory and bringing the boy home.
movies.tagline: The mission is a man.
movies.title: Saving Private Ryan

movies.overview: Arkham Asylum has been destroyed, and all its inmates have been unleashed upon Gotham City. As Batman races to round up some of his greatest enemies, he is pushed to his physical and mental limits and into a final confrontation with a new threat: the man called Bane!
movies.title: Batman: Knightfall Part 1: Knightfall

movies.overview: WWII American Army Medic Desmond T. Doss, who served during the Battle of Okinawa, refuses to kill people and becomes the first Conscientious Objector in American history to receive the Congressional Medal of Honor.
movies.tagline: One of the greatest heroes in American history never fired a bullet.
movies.title: Hacksaw Ridge

movies.overview: Marty Mauser, a young man with a dream no one respects, goes to hell and back in pursuit of greatness.
movies.tagline: Dream big.
movies.title: Marty Supreme

movies.overview: A man with a low IQ has accomplished great things in his life and been present during significant historic events—in each case, far exceeding what anyone imagined he could do. But despite all he has achieved, his one true love eludes him.
movies.tagline: The world will never be the same once you've seen it through the eyes of Forrest Gump.
movies.title: Forrest Gump

movies.overview: On his first day on the job as a narcotics officer, a rookie cop works with a rogue detective who isn't what he appears.
movies.tagline: The only thing more dangerous than the line being crossed, is the cop who will cross it.
movies.title: Training Day

movies.overview: The true story of how businessman Oskar Schindler saved over a thousand Jewish lives from the Nazis while they worked as slaves in his factory during World War II.
movies.tagline: Whoever saves one life, saves the world entire.
movies.title: Schindler's List
